description: This file contains functions for updating boot configuration partitions and performing system upgrades on Sony devices, including handling partition updates, flashing kernel and root filesystem images, and managing backup configurations during upgrade.

methods.name: update_bootconfig
methods.description: Updates boot configuration stored at specific MMC partitions by modifying specific offsets with new index values, handling both '0:BOOTCONFIG' and '0:BOOTCONFIG1' partitions if they exist.

methods.name: sony_emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs system upgrade by flashing kernel and root filesystem from a tar archive, updating boot configuration, formatting the rootfs_data partition, and handling backups.
